All these cookie crumbs are on the floor!
The cookie is gone from the jar.
The cookies are all gone!
You can help yourself to one cookie at a time.
Someone took the last cookie.
The last cookie got taken.
That cookie disappeared so fast!
Who took the last cookie then?
We don't have any cookies left at all!
Every single cookie is gone!
You didn't take it and I didn't either.

items.scene: child insisting they are not tired at bedtime

lines.t: You say you are not tired at all!
Look at this cozy pillow, so soft!
Look at all these warm blankets.
The pillow is so nice and fluffy.
Your eyes are getting droopy though!
You can tuck yourself into bed.
You snuggled yourself under the blanket!
You pulled up the blanket.
The blanket got pulled right up.
You slept so long last night!
Why do you think you are not tired?
You haven't yawned even once tonight!
All your stuffed animals are ready for bed!
